excerpts: Command A+ is an open source model with 25 billion active parameters and 218B total parameters model optimized for agentic, multilingual, and reasoning-heavy tasks with a focus on enterprise performance, while also providing support for vision inputs for processing image inputs.
* Model Size: 25B active parameters, 218B total parameters

**Model Architecture**: Command A+ is a decoder-only Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformer Model. With 25B active parameters and 218B total parameters, it has 128 experts, out of which 8 are active per token, and a single shared expert is applied to all tokens. The attention layers interleave sliding-window attention layers with Rotational Positional Embeddings and global attention layers without positional embeddings in a 3:1 ratio, as first introduced in Command A. The sparse MoE layer is trained in a fully dropless manner and uses a token-choice router. We use additive-bias-based load balancing to encourage balanced token load across all experts, and swap out the softmax router activation
**Context Length:** Command A+ supports a context length of 128K & 64K output length.
